mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity valuations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.5 million units signals strong housing demand and rising consumer confidence, which forecasts improved corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 50% of instances despite HOUST > 1.5 million, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 110.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity and deteriorating business conditions, which leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, leading to higher discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when both CPIAUCSL > 205.0 and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 370 billion dollars signals strong consumer demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 50% of instances despite RSAFS > 370B, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment and decline in unemployment rate signals a strong labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 100k in 3 months and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 11500 billion dollars signals strong aggregate demand and economic momentum, which forecasts higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 50% of instances despite GDPC1 > 11500B, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
